Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target sprite atlas. Image 2 is the user's screenshot and the authoritative HEADWEAR SHAPE reference. Correct every resident's headwear to match that screenshot: a single draped towel-like rectangular cloth over the crown, hanging straight down either side/back of the head, held on by a visible dark circular cord RING around the head at forehead height. Similar to a draped ghutra with agal. NOT a wound turban. The ENTIRE FACE must be uncovered: visible forehead, eyes, nose, cheeks, mouth and chin. No cloth across nose/mouth/chin, no face mask, no veil, no bandana. Remove old lower-face cloth and leave a small neck collar only. Cloth on the head hangs vertically at the sides rather than winding diagonally across the crown. The ring is clearly readable across the front/top, as in screenshot.
Preserve each character's existing skin tone, eye design, gender, age, species, clothing colors, body proportions, seated south-facing upper-body pose. Head cloth retains the prior headwear COLOR; new ring dark charcoal/brown with subtle colored accent like reference. Distinct uncovered faces with small natural noses/mouths; do not alter identity. No chairs or tables, no legs, no ground.
Output exactly FOUR columns and 5 rows with generous transparent gutters. One character per row in original order. Four poses: rest eyes open; subtle inhale eyes open with IDENTICAL FACE; half blink; eyes fully closed. Faces and headwear pixel-identical between frames except eyelids, no warping. Clean crisp RPG pixel art, hard square pixels, 40–48 logical pixels per character, no blur, no smooth shading or antialiasing. Transparent background. No text or labels. Suri: brown-skinned woman, indigo draped cloth plus ring, teal clothes. Tavin: tan man, rust-red draped cloth plus ring, cream shirt/blue collar. Una: tan woman, ivory draped cloth plus ring, ochre clothes/rust collar.
